description: This file defines the class 'SessionActorQueue', which manages asynchronous queues for session actors, tracking pending operations per session and providing methods for queue management and status retrieval.

classes.name: SessionActorQueue
classes.description: A class that manages asynchronous queue operations for session actors, tracking pending operations, and providing methods to access queue status and perform queued operations.

methods.name: getTailMapForTesting
methods.description: Returns the internal tail map from the queue for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTotalPendingCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pending operations across all sessions.

methods.name: getPendingCountForSession
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations for a specific session actor identified by 'actorKey'.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Enqueues an asynchronous operation for a specific session actor, updating the pending count before and after execution.
